decisions.reason: After four years this low-cost accessory would likely have revealed its demand, and as a cheap complement to the core trailer business it still makes sense to retain.

The car transporter line is a more specialized and costlier option, and by now the learning period is largely over, so limited strategic fit or weak volume would justify reallocating resources elsewhere.
This cover series supports existing trailer sales, is inexpensive to carry, and if it has remained viable this long it likely strengthens the overall offering enough to continue.
With the other box trailer series already removed, this line appears to be the retained core variant, so continued presence is more valuable than another rationalization step.
